title: Canonical rational and scalar-size factors of cohomology realization
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$,
an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a separated finite-type
$k_0$-scheme $Y_0$, a compactification $c_0$ of its structural morphism,
and $\epsilon\in\{\mathrm{ordinary},\mathrm{compact}\}$.
Use the canonical realization data of
[def-weil-frobenius-cohomology-realization-data].
For every finite coefficient stage $E\subset\Omega$, let $E_{\rm sm}$ be
its specified small coefficient field and $C_E$ its rational constructible
stage category. Define $H_E:C_E\to D(E_{\rm sm})$ as the recorded rational
$\epsilon$-cohomology functor followed by inclusion of its finite-dimensional
point-fibre target. Define $A_E:D(E_{\rm sm})\to D(\Omega)$ as the recorded
scalar-and-size extension along the specified embedding $E_{\rm sm}\to\Omega$.
For $E\le L$, write $F_{EL}:D(E_{\rm sm})\to D(L_{\rm sm})$ for derived
scalar extension, and $T_{EL}:C_E\to C_L$ for the original stage transition
[def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category]. Define
$p_{EL}:F_{EL}\circ A_L\xrightarrow{\sim}A_E$ by the normalized balanced
tensor comparison followed by the equality of stage embeddings. Here composites
are written in diagram order. Define
$q_{EL}:H_E\circ F_{EL}\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{EL}\circ H_L$ by the recorded
rational scalar comparison followed by the inverse operation-stage transition
comparison. For $E\le L\le N$, define
$c_{ELN}:F_{EL}\circ F_{LN}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{EN}$ by the specified derived
field-scalar tower followed by equality of the composed coefficient inclusions
[lem-weil-derived-field-scalar-extension-tower]. All five constructions are
explicit composites of existing functors and natural isomorphisms. More
generally, for arbitrary fields $F,G,H$ and maps $\varphi:F\to G$,
$\psi:G\to H$, $\theta:F\to H$ with $\psi\varphi=\theta$, construct
$c(\varphi,\psi,\theta)$ by the same field-scalar tower and equality recipe.
For any field $\Omega'$ and maps $a:G\to\Omega'$, $b:F\to\Omega'$ with
$a\varphi=b$, construct $p(\varphi,a,b)$ by the same scalar-and-size tower
and equality recipe. The stage comparisons above are the specializations of
these two generic constructors.
For abstract functors and comparisons of these forms, define a coefficient record
with fields A,F,c,p and a full factor record extending it with H,q. Its stage
functor is H_E followed by A_E. Its comparison is the whiskered inverse p
followed by the whiskered q, with explicit functor associators. Define the
rational cocycle predicate by F_LN(q_EL,K);q_LN,T_EL(K);H_N(a_ELN,K)
=c_ELN,H_E(K);q_EN,K. Define the coefficient cocycle predicate as the natural-isomorphism equality
(c_ELN whiskered by A_N);p_EN = associator;(F_EL whiskered with p_LN);p_EL.
Its proved component formula is
A_N(c_ELN,V);p_EN,V=p_LN,F_EL(V);p_EL,V. The rational equation is an
objectwise equation in the stated category. Given explicit coefficient factors
and a proof of their natural-isomorphism equation, the generic bundled
constructor returns those exact fields with that proof. It performs no choice or replacement of data. The derived
category families are the specified small models.

source.place: (1.1.1)(d), canonical iterated coefficient extension, and (1.1.14), ordinary and compact cohomology; explicit factor of Steps 1--2 of the parent proof.

proof.text: Construct the generic scalar associator from fieldScalarTower followed by eqToIso for the composite field-map equality, and the generic scalar-and-size comparison from frobeniusCoefficientTower followed by eqToIso for the embedding equality. Specialize these constructed comparisons to the recorded coefficient inclusions and stage embeddings.

Construct H by composing the recorded rational cohomology functor with inclusion of the finite-dimensional point category. Construct q by whiskering the recorded rational scalar comparison with that inclusion, then composing with the whiskered inverse operation-stage transition comparison. These are the prescribed maps, with no existence choice or additional coherence assumption.

Define the abstract coefficient record with fields A,F,c,p and the full comparison record extending it with H,q. Define the composite stage and comparison by whiskering and explicit functor associators. Define the rational cocycle by its component equation and the coefficient cocycle by its natural-isomorphism equality. Apply the hom component at V to prove the displayed coefficient component formula; the functor associator has identity components. The generic bundled constructor takes explicit coefficient fields and their proved natural-isomorphism equation, returning that literal record with the supplied proof. Its data are independent of the proof. Define the chosen small derived category family by the canonical derived-category structures.

mathlib_searches.query: The natural scalar extension comparison of cohomology respects a tower of coefficient field embeddings
mathlib_searches.results: AlgHom.extendScalars and scalar-tower instances; no theorem for the normalized operation and point-fibre comparisons.

mathlib_searches.query: Compatible scalar extension natural isomorphisms yield invariance of conjugated functor maps at larger coefficient stages
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.extendScalarsComp and extendScalars_assoc supply the ordinary module tensor comparison, not its specified scalar-and-size realization or operation mates.

mathlib_searches.results: stageBeta_coherence concerns pulled-back source/target operations. PointScalarNormalization is a different point-only statement. No result for these factor comparisons.

from.place: Canonical coefficient realization of the ordinary and compact cohomology complexes, coefficient enlargement; parent proof Steps 1 and 2.

lean.statement:
def rationalComparison (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L) :
    rationalStage l Ω D hl Y₀ c₀ compact E ⋙
        DerivedCategory.fieldDerivedScalarExtension
          (coefficientInclusion.{u} l Ω E L h).toRingHom ≅
      (stageSystem l Ω (D.geometricFiber Y₀).left).T h ⋙
        rationalStage l Ω D hl Y₀ c₀ compact L
